source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: TR-909 drum machine (bass drum, snare, toms, rim shot, clap, hi-hats, crash and ride) with per-voice level, tune and decay, and shuffle. The most used machine in the repo's Buzz songs.
quirks: It plays from trigger columns, not notes: each track has BD Trigger … RC Trigger switches (a 1 hits that drum). notes_write can't play it, and param_set can't set the triggers; songs that use it carry their own patterns.
Silent at its defaults until a trigger fires (profile).
Tune and decay are bare 0–63 scales; levels go to about 200%.
Closed source: names and units come from its own descriptions and texts; the trigger columns from the repo songs' saved parameter tables.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
ExternalMachines/source/buzztrax-buzzmachines/Oomek/Exciter/test.bmx — a repo song using it (six do); its saved parameter table lists the 11 trigger columns
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-03) — silent from a note: no Note parameter

problems: no sound from a MIDI note at its defaults (it has no Note track parameter)
